Name: Claudio
Description: Claudio on your Stream Deck: correct, translate and arrange your windows, with a key for each.

com.okonoma.claudio.action.Name: Claudio action
com.okonoma.claudio.action.Tooltip: Runs one of Claudio's actions on the current selection.

com.okonoma.claudio.dictate.Name: Dictate
com.okonoma.claudio.dictate.Tooltip: Hold the key to dictate; let go and Claudio writes it down.

com.okonoma.claudio.window.Name: Window
com.okonoma.claudio.window.Tooltip: Sends the frontmost window where you want it.

com.okonoma.claudio.face.Name: Claudio's face
com.okonoma.claudio.face.Tooltip: Shows Claudio's face across the page's fifteen keys.

com.okonoma.claudio.navigate.Name: Navigation
com.okonoma.claudio.navigate.Tooltip: Moves between the pages of the Claudio profile.
